name: Ellie Schiller Homosassa Springs Wildlife State Park
area: 4150 S Suncoast Boulevard, Homosassa, Citrus County
coordinateNote: Approximate western wildlife/spring park location, not the US 19 visitor-center entrance. Use 4150 S Suncoast Boulevard for the main road entrance; suspended boat shuttle means transport must be checked. Approximation uses the area/address in the listed location source; not a measured or geocoded entrance.
experience: Manatees below the Fish Bowl observatory, plus alligators, black bears, red wolves and other native animal exhibits along the Wildlife Walk. This is a substantial animal park built around a spring, with above- and below-water viewing. The observatory reopened in October 2025 and requires stairs. Public swimming in the park's main spring is not offered.
cost: Adults 13+ $13, children 6–12 $5, younger free per official park page.
access: 9 a.m.–5:30 p.m.; ticket counters close 4:45 p.m. No public swimming in the wildlife-park spring.

name: Krul Recreation Area, Blackwater River State Forest
coordinateNote: Entrance or parking coordinates from the November 12, 2026 gap review.

navigationNote: Drive to the listed entrance; follow the access description on arrival.
experience: Swim off the dock in the 6.5-acre lake, fed by springs at its north end, then walk the accessible boardwalk section of the Sweetwater Trail over the suspension bridge and past the gristmill; the trail continues 1.3 miles to Bear Lake. name: Lake Panasoffkee Tract campground (Southwest Florida Water Management District)
coordinateNote: Entrance, parking or campsite coordinates from the November 12, 2026 research.
navigationNote: Drive to the listed entrance; follow the access description on arrival.
experience: Open-field and oak-shade sites with picnic tables and fire rings on a 9,911-acre preserve; you park next to your site. It sits on SR 44 between I-75 and Inverness, about 28 miles straight-line east of Crystal River and about 25 miles from Rainbow Springs, so it works for the Nov 21, 22, 23 and Nov 30 nights. Directory reviewers say it books up around hunts and the host does not like late arrivals.
access: Free permit or reservation required before arrival. Stay limit: 7 consecutive days, 30 days per calendar year; arrive after 3 p.m., leave by 11 a.m. District closes this campground for its hunts: closed Nov 15-20, Dec 6-11 and Dec 15-20, 2026. Open Nov 21 - Dec 5. Reserve at the latest the day before arrival; bookings open 30 days ahead; maximum two active reservations at a time. Water on site is nonpotable.

conditions.summary: Open Nov 21 - Dec 5, 2026 between two hunt closures (Nov 15-20 and Dec 6-11). Free reservation required and cannot be made for the same day. (source dated read 2026-11-12)
